messages:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up for the Acadia QBR prep 1 1 1 - spotting a sudden surge in embeddings over the last week, could be a renewal risk if left unmitigated. tagging finops + enablement.

dan_finops: Can you drop the numbers? need 7d vs prior 7d and any top routes so we can decide throttle vs one-off credit.

maria_cs: snapshot below (7d vs prior 7d):

```
embeds: 6.1M (was 1.1M) -> +455%
avg tokens/day: 420k (was 82k)
est monthly delta: ~$50k (was ~$12k)
main routes: /v1/embed-bulk (63%), /v1/chat/realtime (22%), misc scheduled jobs (15%)
no embedding-specific alerts configured
```

maria_cs: billing-bot didnt escalate (no high-cost alert), so this got through. leaving note for leo and sam to own customer ops. :grimacing:

billing-bot: Notice: Acadia embedding units exceed baseline threshold. Recommend review and guardrail.

leo_onboard: I'll check recent SDK versions and any new cron jobs on their side. if bulk calls are unbatched that's a classic leak.

sam_success: My short playbook: 1) finops estimates and temporary budget cap, 2) enablement outreach with batching + cache guidance + snippet, 3) set alerting + offer one-off credit if disruption risk. Can we run a 20m sync today?

dan_finops: I'll run the numbers and propose a soft cap per-route. Early analysis: capping embed-bulk to 12rps reduces projected monthly delta by ~68% (~$34k savings). Propose route cap + alert at 40% usage.

leo_onboard: drafting quick enablement note. planning to include code patterns and a recommended batching window. example: use 256-512 items per batch, debounce rapid client retries. snippet: 

```
# pseudo
items_groups = group(items, 300)
for g in items_groups:
    client.embed(g)
# prefer async batch and reuse cached vectors when possible
```

maria_cs: action list: dan - enable cap + alert (today), leo - outreach draft (today), sam - lead customer sync (by EOD), platform - add embedding alert (ops).

dan_finops: done - applied temp cap on route embed-bulk (cap=12rps) and created alert at 2x baseline. Estimated immediate monthly savings: ~$34k. If Acadia pushes back, we can offer a temporary credit while they fix client behavior.

sam_success: scheduled 20m sync at 16:30 PT, invite sent to their PM + infra lead. we'll walk batching guidance and offer a short remediation window.

maria_cs: I'll update the QBR deck with the cost delta, mitigation steps, and risk rating in the account health slide. add note to recommend embedding guardrail to other similar accounts.

leo_onboard: I'll add an "embed-efficiency" checklist to our onboarding repo and a one-pager to the enablement kit.

billing-bot: Temp cap applied: embed-bulk=12rps. Monitoring for throttles and will escalate if error rates spike.
